heating.name: Autoterm Comfort Controller
heating.description: Phone-controllable diesel heater controller with timer, thermostat and remote temperature sensor.
heating.notes: Worth every penny. Set your morning temperature from bed. Your partner will thank you.

heating.name: Webasto DBW 2000 Diesel Heater
heating.description: Premium diesel heater. Quiet, reliable, low 12V draw (~3A). Used in OEM VW Transporters.
heating.notes: OEM quality. Specify at conversion time — retrofitting adds cost and complexity.

heating.name: Planar 2D Diesel Heater
heating.description: Russian-made diesel heater, popular in van conversions. 2kW output, compact footprint.
heating.notes: Solid value option. Combine with Autoterm controller for phone control.

solar.name: Bimble Solar 400W Starter Kit
solar.description: Complete solar setup: 2x 200W panels, MPPT controller, cables, fixings, and instructions.
solar.notes: This is what I use. Overkill for summer, perfect for year-round wild camping.

solar.name: Victron SmartSolar MPPT 100/20
solar.description: Bluetooth-enabled MPPT charge controller. Monitors via Victron Connect app.
solar.notes: The standard for van builds. See real-time solar input from your phone.

batteries.name: Bimble 100Ah LiFePO4 Leisure Battery
batteries.description: Lithium iron phosphate battery. 100Ah usable (vs ~50Ah in lead-acid). 2000+ cycle life.
batteries.notes: The upgrade that makes off-grid van life genuinely comfortable. Worth the premium.

batteries.name: Renogy 100Ah AGM Deep Cycle Battery
batteries.description: Budget leisure battery option. 100Ah AGM, maintenance-free. ~50Ah usable capacity.
batteries.notes: Fine starting point. Upgrade to lithium when budget allows.

bike-racks.name: Atera Strada Vario 3 Bike Rack
bike-racks.description: Towbar-mounted rack for up to 3 bikes. Works with barn doors — folds away cleanly. 60kg capacity.
bike-racks.notes: Best option for barn door setups. Swings out around the doors — no need to remove it.

bike-racks.name: Thule EPos 2 Bike Towbar Rack
bike-racks.description: Premium towbar-mounted rack for 2 bikes. Tool-free bike fastening, 60kg capacity.
bike-racks.notes: Premium choice if you're carrying e-bikes or value tool-free loading.

roof-racks.name: Reimo Van Top Roof Rack
roof-racks.description: Purpose-built roof rack for T5/T6. Powder-coated steel. Compatible with most pop-tops and high-roofs.
roof-racks.notes: Good for boards, kayaks, or extra kit. Check pop-top compatibility before ordering.

awnings.name: Fiamma F45S Retractable Awning
awnings.description: Wall-mounted retractable awning for VW Transporters. 2.5m or 3m width. UV-stabilised canopy.
awnings.notes: The go-to choice for T5/T6. Fits tidily on the factory roof rail. No drilling required.

awnings.name: Kiravans Awning Rail Kit
awnings.description: Side-door awning rail for T5/T6. Accepts drive-away tents from Outdoor Revolution, Vango etc.
awnings.notes: Essential if you want a drive-away tent. Fits most T5/T6 — check compatibility with your tent.

insurance.name: Brentacre Campervan Insurance
insurance.description: Specialist campervan insurance. Covers conversions, new for old, European breakdown. Free agreed value.
insurance.notes: Consistently best value for T5/T6. Get a quote before committing elsewhere.

inspection.name: RAC Pre-Purchase Inspection
inspection.description: Independent vehicle inspection before buying. 82-point check covering mechanical, bodywork, and history.
inspection.notes: Non-negotiable for private purchases. £300 now or a £3,000 surprise later.

inspection.name: HPI Check
inspection.description: Full vehicle history check: finance outstanding, stolen, written off, mileage discrepancies.
inspection.notes: Do this before every private purchase. Never skip it — takes 5 minutes online.

bed-mattresses.name: Edge Campervans RIB112 Mattress Topper
bed-mattresses.description: Purpose-made memory foam topper for RIB Altair bed systems. Folds with the bed.
bed-mattresses.notes: The difference between 'camping sleep' and actual sleep. Buy this at conversion time.

towbars.name: Westfalia Detachable Towbar (T6)
towbars.description: OEM-quality detachable towbar for VW T6. 13-pin electrics, 2000kg towing capacity.
towbars.notes: Detachable is worth the extra cost — remove it when you don't need it.
